items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma, opening with the slogan that the scheme-theoretic image exists: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S there is a closed subspace Z through which f factors and which is contained in every other closed subspace with that property (source lines 3200-3209). The proof takes the kernel ideal of O_Y -> f_*O_X, notes that if it were quasi-coherent the closed subscheme it defines would do, and then invokes the existence of the largest quasi-coherent subsheaf of a given submodule to produce the required ideal in general.
